# opencode-mnemon

OpenCode plugin for **project-scoped automatic memory** on top of the [mnemon](https://github.com/dsh) CLI.

Conversation turns are captured at runtime, distilled (rules first, LLM as fallback), written back through `mnemon remember`, and a gated slice of memory is re-injected ephemerally before every model request. No per-user setup: memories land in `<cwd>/.mnemon/` when the project has one, and fall back to `~/.mnemon` when it does not.

## Installation

Prerequisite: the mnemon CLI on `PATH`:

```sh
npm install --global @mnemon-dev/mnemon
mnemon --version
```

Register the plugin once, globally — either edit `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`:

```json
{
  "plugins": [
    "opencode-mnemon"
  ]
}
```

or run:

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-mnemon
```

Then restart the OpenCode server (plugins load at startup) and verify:

```sh
opencode plugin list    # mnemon  x.y.z  opencode-mnemon
```

Later updates: `opencode plugin update opencode-mnemon`, then restart the server.

One registration, one copy. Do NOT also drop `mnemon.js` into a plugins directory, and do NOT run `mnemon setup --target opencode` while the npm package is registered — both install a second copy under the same plugin id `"mnemon"` and OpenCode aborts with `Duplicate plugin ID`, blocking all plugin updates.

## What it does

Two sides, sharing one mnemon store.

| Side | Trigger | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| **Write** | `session.text.ended` | Append the turn to a per-project runtime file, then after a 60s finalize window claim + extract + `mnemon remember` (async, BUSY backoff) |
| **Read** | `context` hook (every model call, ephemeral) | Inject a quality-gated recall section + cached one-line status + workspace-doc hints + cross-session runtime turns. Empty recall → status line at most, otherwise nothing. The `prompt` hook only stashes the user text for the write side — it never rewrites `prompt.text`, so injection does not accumulate in session history |

Three layers, mirroring dsh-mnemon:

```
.mnemon/
  runtime/      per-session scratch (this plugin owns opencode-memories.json)
  data/         the mnemon store (sqlite graph)
  documents/    read-only: indexed for recall, never auto-written
```

## Recall quality gate

`mnemon recall` has no `--min-score`, and `--limit N` pads to N with graph/temporal neighbours when intent auto-detects to WHY/WHEN/ENTITY — so the plugin gates results before injection (task 10-11):

- Messages under 6 non-whitespace characters skip the recall spawn entirely (`删` / `继续` measured zero evidence hits).
- Results are oversampled (`--limit 12 --verbose`), then filtered in order: invalid or `>1` scores drop, `< 0.25` drops, `< topScore − 0.15` drops, and items with `keyword+entity+similarity === 0` are treated as *padding* — dropped whenever any lexical hit exists. All padding → the whole section is omitted, and with it the docs/runtime/hint sections: an empty-recall turn ships the cached status line at most (~200 chars), or nothing when even status is empty. The USAGE_HINT only earns its ~330 chars on turns where something was actually recalled.
- Same-session runtime entries are excluded by default: they are already in the model's context, and repeating them pays for the same text twice. They return after a restart, in another session, or post-compaction. `MNEMON_RUNTIME_SCOPE=all` restores the old behavior.
- Kept results (≤ 4) render as compact lines (`— [0.38·preference] excerpt…`, section ≤ 900 chars); the ~30 KB verbose JSON only feeds `JSON.parse`, never the model context. The status section is compressed to one line (≤ 200 chars) and cached 60s per memory root.
- Empty or unparseable CLI output (observed `SQLITE_BUSY`) retries once after 150ms, then drops the section — injection never fails.
- The hint tells the model deep retrieval is on demand: `mnemon recall "<focused query>" --intent WHY|WHEN|ENTITY --limit 10 --verbose`.

This is noise reduction, not precision engineering: this store's scores cluster in 0.25–0.38, so the gate promises only that zero-signal padding never reaches the context.

## Hard invariants

These are load-bearing. Breaking them corrupts shared state.

- **Never write to `runtime/memories.json`.** That file is dsh-mnemon's own runtime memory with a different schema (`{content, created_at, target, importance}`). OpenCode uses `runtime/opencode-memories.json` (+ `.opencode-memories.lock`) instead. The 50-entry trim would otherwise delete dsh's entries.
- **Never write to `documents/`.** Index it, don't own it.
- **Claim leases, not permanent marks.** Claims write `claimedAt`; a claim older than 300s can be taken over. Permanent marks have stalled 11 entries before.
- **Rule extract first, LLM only as a fallback.** `extractMemory(entry) ?? (await llmExtractMemory(entry))`. LLM calls never enter the writer lock, time out at 25s (`unref`), and fail silently back to the rule result.
- **LLM entry point is `ctx.generate.text`, not a session.** `ctx.session.prompt` is not on the V2 `ctx`, and `generate.text` does not re-enter the session prompt hook, so there is no recursion. The `[mnemon-extract]` marker is kept as a textual backstop.

## Deployment model

**推荐：从 npm 安装**。在全局 `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` 的 `plugins` 数组声明发布包，由 OpenCode 自动拉取：

```json
{
  "plugins": [
    "opencode-mnemon"
  ]
}
```

OpenCode 会从 npm 安装到本地缓存（`~/.cache/opencode/npm/opencode-mnemon@latest/`），`opencode plugin list` 应看到 `mnemon` 插件。

**本地回退（不使用 npm 声明的环境）**：用仓库脚本复制到插件槽——注意是**复制**不是符号链接（R11 教训：仓库改名会让符号链接悬空、插件静默失效）。

```sh
npm run deploy                  # ~/.config/opencode/plugins/mnemon.js <- 仓库 mnemon.js（原子替换）
npm run deploy -- --check       # 只比对哈希，不写；漂移非零退出
npm run deploy -- --dry-run     # 打印将要做什么，不写
```

`deploy --check` 的退出码：`0` 同步 / `1` 漂移或源不可读 / `2` 从未部署。测试和 CI 可据此判断是否真的部署过，避免把"本机未部署"误判成"漂移失败"。

> ⚠️ 二选一：npm 声明和 copy 部署**只能留一个**。两者并存 = 同一个 `"mnemon"` id 注册两次，`plugin update` 直接报 `Duplicate plugin ID` 中止。用了 npm 版就别再 `npm run deploy`。

## Per-project memory init（记忆层初始化）

插件是全局的，记忆库按项目隔离：`<project>/.mnemon/` 存在即用项目库，否则回退全局 `~/.mnemon`。新项目建库：

```sh
cd <project>
npx opencode-mnemon         # 在 cwd 建 .mnemon/
npx opencode-mnemon <dir>   # 或指向别的目录
# 旧别名 npx -p opencode-mnemon opencode-mnemon-init 仍可用
```

它创建 `runtime/`、`documents/{active,archived,index.json}`（空库写 `{"documents": []}`，已有不覆盖）和目录内 `.gitignore`（只忽略机器本地的 `data/` + `runtime/`，`documents/` 照常可版本化），最后用 `mnemon --data-dir … status` 证明 CLI 可达并预建 sqlite。幂等：已存在的文件一律保留。

它**绝不碰** `.opencode/` 和项目根 `.gitignore`。如果项目是老办法（官方 `mnemon setup --target opencode`）建的，残留的 `.opencode/plugins/mnemon.js` / `.opencode/skills/mnemon` 会触发警告——删掉它，它和 npm 包重复注册。

## Testing

```sh
npm test                          # rebuild the test copy, then run all five suites
npm run test:deploy               # same, but against $PWD/mnemon.js instead of the live deploy
```

Suites:

| File | Coverage |
|---|---|
| `tests/mnemon-recall-gate-test.mjs` | Recall gate: query floor, score/band/signal filtering, compact-line budgets, status compression + TTL cache |
| `tests/mnemon-extract-test.mjs` | Rule extraction: headlines, entities, categories, fence ratio, dedupe |
| `tests/mnemon-remember-e2e.mjs` | Real `mnemon remember --data-dir` round trip; global-root isolation |
| `tests/mnemon-llm-extract-test.mjs` | LLM switch matrix, model catalog resolution, prompt/parse, timeout, silent fallback |
| `tests/mnemon-init-test.mjs` | Init scaffolding: fresh layout, idempotent rerun, explicit dir, legacy-duplicate warning, `--help`/`--version` |

Tests import `/tmp/mnemon-test-plugin.mjs`, a copy of the plugin with internals appended as exports. **Always run `tests/build-mnemon-test.sh` after editing** — otherwise you are testing a stale copy. The production file stays in its clean `{ id, setup, server }` shape.

`build-mnemon-test.sh` accepts the source path as `$1` or `$MNEMON_PLUGIN_PATH`; with neither, it uses the live deployment and falls back to the repo copy when no deployment exists (fresh clone, CI). Set `MNEMON_REQUIRE_DEPLOYMENT=1` to disable that fallback.

### Environment overrides

| Variable | Effect |
|----------|--------|
| `MNEMON_BIN` | Path to the `mnemon` CLI the e2e suite drives. Defaults to bare `mnemon` on `PATH`. |
| `MNEMON_TASK_DIR_OPTIONAL=1` | Allow `sync:docs:check` to skip when no Trellis task directory exists. Without it the check fails, since a comparison against nothing is not a pass. |
| `MNEMON_TEST_DST` | Where the exported test copy is written. Defaults to `/tmp/mnemon-test-plugin.mjs`. |

CI (`.github/workflows/test.yml`) installs `@mnemon-dev/mnemon` from npm — it is publicly published with per-platform binaries and needs no credentials — then runs the suite under a scratch `HOME` so the fallback assertions cannot touch a real memory root.

## Switches

| Switch | Scope | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| `<root>/opencode-llm-extract` | per-project | `touch` on, `rm` off, next sweep — no restart |
| `MNEMON_LLM_EXTRACT=1` | process | restart required |
| `MNEMON_LLM_EXTRACT=0` | process | master kill, overrides the flag file |
| `MNEMON_LLM_MODEL` | process | overrides the flag file's model content |
| `MNEMON_LLM_MODELS` | process | comma-separated `provider/model` list overriding the default model chain |
| `MNEMON_AUTOMEM=0` | process | write side off; **read side stays on** |
| `MNEMON_RECALL=0` | process | recall section off; injection carries status at most (docs / runtime / hint stay off) |
| `MNEMON_RUNTIME_SCOPE=all` | process | runtime section includes same-session entries (default: cross-session only) |
| `MNEMON_DEBUG=0` | process | plugin log off entirely |
| `MNEMON_DEBUG_LOG=<path>` | process | override the plugin log path (default: OS temp dir `mnemon-plugin-debug.log`) |
| `MNEMON_DISABLE=1` | process | master kill, **both sides stop** (`TRELLIS_HOOKS=0` / `TRELLIS_DISABLE_HOOKS=1` honored as legacy fallback) |

The flag file's non-empty content is treated as a model ID.

**Env switches are process-level.** Every plugin instance lives in the long-running OpenCode *server* process, so `MNEMON_DISABLE=1 opencode run ...` does nothing — `opencode run` is a client and the env never reaches the server. Export it in the environment that starts the server. This also means env switches cannot be scoped per-project; use the flag file for that.

## LLM model resolution

Models are resolved against the live catalog, never hardcoded — a hardcoded provider that is not in `ctx.model.list()` fails every call.

- `pickModelRef(models, wanted)` searches `[configured, ...llmModelChain()]` in order. Empty catalog → trust the config; nothing matches → `null` and a silent give-up.
- Default chain is `["opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash", "opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash", "opencode-gemini-3.5-flash-lite", "opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-free"]`, overridable wholesale via `MNEMON_LLM_MODELS` (comma-separated `provider/model`). `LLM_MODEL_CHAIN` remains as an alias for compatibility.
- `ctx.model.list()` returns `{ location, data }` — take `.data`.
- The model ref must be `{ id, modelID, providerID }` and **`id` must be the bare modelID**. Passing the full `provider/model` string gets re-joined into `provider/provider/model`. `{ id }` alone fails with `Missing key at ["model"]["providerID"]`; a bare string fails with `Expected Model.Ref | null`. Omitting `model` hits the free tier, which rejects out-of-OpenCode calls.

All of the above was found by probing, not reading docs.

## mnemon invocation

`mnemon` on PATH is an npm JS launcher; `SIGKILL`ing it leaves the native child orphaned. `mnemonCommand()` resolves the real native binary once and caches it: `realpathSync` detects `bin/mnemon.js` → reads `targets.json` for the platform/arch match → `createRequire` resolves the optional dep. On win32 it goes through the `.cmd` shim branch. Resolves to e.g. `.../@mnemon-dev/mnemon-darwin-x64/bin/mnemon`.

## Timing constants

| Constant | Value |
|---|---|
| `MIN_AGE_MS` / `FINALIZE_MS` | 60 000 |
| `BATCH` | 3 |
| `MIN_TOTAL_CHARS` | 24 |
| `SUBSTANTIVE_CHARS` | 60 |
| `MAX_FENCE_RATIO` | 0.7 |
| `ASSISTANT_CHARS` / `USER_CHARS` / `HEADLINE_CHARS` | 700 / 150 / 110 |
| `MAX_ENTITIES` / `MIN_IMP` | 8 / 3 |
| `BUSY_RETRY_MS` | 350 |
| `TAIL_DELAY_MS` | 75 000 |
| `CLAIM_LEASE_MS` | 300 000 |
| `MIN_RUNTIME_TEXT_CHARS` | 20 |
| `RUNTIME_RECENT_COUNT` | 5 |
| `LLM_TIMEOUT_MS` / `LLM_MAX_ENTITIES` | 25 000 / 6 |
| `RECALL_LIMIT` / `RECALL_MAX` | 12 / 4 |
| `RECALL_MIN_SCORE` / `RECALL_BAND` | 0.25 / 0.15 |
| `RECALL_MIN_QCHARS` | 6 |
| `MAX_QUERY_CHARS` | 8000 |
| `RECALL_CACHE_MAX` | 128 |
| `STATUS_TTL_MS` | 60 000 |
| `RECALL_SECTION_MAX_CHARS` / `STATUS_SECTION_MAX_CHARS` | 900 / 200 |

`MIN_RUNTIME_TEXT_CHARS` drops short turns **silently** — a probe that replies `好` will look like a broken pipeline. It is not.

## Debugging

- Plugin log: `$TMPDIR/mnemon-plugin-debug.log` (override with `MNEMON_DEBUG_LOG`, off with `MNEMON_DEBUG=0`), grep `mnemon-auto` (append / remember / `llm extract ok|drop|skipped` / sweep / lease / `recall gate: kept= dropped= padding= reason= ms= chars= status=cached|spawn` / `context inject`). Rotates at 8 MB to `.log.1` / `.log.2`, so an investigation can still read the previous generation after a rotation lands mid-diagnosis. Per-event streaming traffic is deliberately not logged.
- Load log: `~/.local/share/opencode/log/opencode.log`, `loading plugin` / `failed to load plugin` — the raw counts are inflated; filter with `grep -av "spawning process"`

## Project conventions

- Config files (JSON, `.env`, `package.json`) use **tabs**, not spaces.
- This repo is the single source of truth. There is no per-project copy: `BalanceDeck/.opencode/plugins/mnemon.js` was deleted as a stale fork.

## Documentation

`docs/prd.md`, `docs/design.md`, `docs/implement.md` hold the requirements, technical design, and the execution record with verification evidence. The Trellis task directory at `~/project/others/.trellis/tasks/10-11-mnemon-recall-gate/` is the working copy; `docs/` is a one-way snapshot of it, kept in git because that task directory is not version controlled anywhere.

Edit the task documents, then sync:

```
npm run sync:docs          # copy prd/design/implement into docs/
npm run sync:docs:check    # report drift only; non-zero exit on drift
```

`npm test` runs the check, so a stale snapshot fails the suite. `docs/` is derived: never edit it directly, your changes will be overwritten on the next sync.

The script finds the task directory whether it is still active (`tasks/<slug>/`) or already archived (`tasks/archive/<YYYY-MM>/<slug>/`) — archiving moves it, and an archived task is still the source of record. Override with `MNEMON_TASK_DIR=...` or a positional path.

**If no task directory is found, the check fails rather than passing.** A check that cannot find its source has verified nothing, and exiting clean would read as protection while checking nothing. On a machine that genuinely has no Trellis task directory, opt out explicitly:

```
MNEMON_TASK_DIR_OPTIONAL=1 npm test
```

Not covered by the sync: `tests/`. Those are live code here, not a snapshot, so they are never written from the task directory. `build-mnemon-test.sh` intentionally differs from the archived copy — the repo version accepts `MNEMON_PLUGIN_PATH` and a path argument and validates the source exists, while the archived one hardcodes the live deployment path. The archived copy stays as it is: it is the frozen record of what that task produced, and rewriting it would misrepresent that.

# opencode-mnemon

基于 [mnemon](https://github.com/dsh) CLI 的 OpenCode 插件，提供**按项目隔离的自动记忆**。

对话回合在运行时被捕获、蒸馏（先规则、LLM 兜底），通过 `mnemon remember` 写回，并在每次模型调用前以临时副本形式重新注入一段经过质量闸门筛选的记忆。无需逐个用户配置：当项目存在 `<cwd>/.mnemon/` 时记忆落在项目本地，否则回退到 `~/.mnemon`。

## 安装

前置：`PATH` 上有 mnemon CLI：

```sh
npm install --global @mnemon-dev/mnemon
mnemon --version
```

全局注册一次即可——改 `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`：

```json
{
  "plugins": [
    "opencode-mnemon"
  ]
}
```

或运行：

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-mnemon
```

然后重启 OpenCode server（插件在启动时加载），验证：

```sh
opencode plugin list    # mnemon  x.y.z  opencode-mnemon
```

以后更新：`opencode plugin update opencode-mnemon`，再重启 server。

一份注册、一份拷贝。不要再往插件目录手放 `mnemon.js`，也不要在 npm 包已注册时跑 `mnemon setup --target opencode`——两种都会装出第二个同 id `"mnemon"` 副本，OpenCode 直接报 `Duplicate plugin ID` 中止，所有插件更新都被卡住。

## 它做什么

读写两侧共享同一个 mnemon 存储。

| 侧 | 触发 | 效果 |
|---|---|---|
| **写** | `session.text.ended` | 把回合追加到项目级 runtime 文件，60s 收尾窗口后 claim + 抽取 + `mnemon remember`（异步，SQLite BUSY 退避） |
| **读** | `context` hook（每次模型调用，临时副本） | 注入质量闸门筛选的召回段 + 缓存的一行状态 + 工作区文档提示 + 跨会话运行时回合。空召回时至多带状态行，否则空。`prompt` hook 只做写侧 stash，不改写 `prompt.text`，注入不进历史 |

三层结构，与 dsh-mnemon 对齐：

```
.mnemon/
  runtime/      每会话临时区（本插件持有 opencode-memories.json）
  data/         mnemon 存储（sqlite 图）
  documents/    只读：参与召回索引，绝不自动写入
```

## 召回质量闸门

`mnemon recall` 没有 `--min-score`，且 `--limit N` 在意图命中 WHY/WHEN/ENTITY 时用图/时间邻居补到 N——所以插件在注入前先做闸门过滤（task 10-11）：

- 少于 6 个非空白字符的消息完全跳过召回（实测「删」/「继续」零证据命中）。
- 结果过采样（`--limit 12 --verbose`），然后依次过滤：非法或 `>1` 的分数丢弃，`< 0.25` 丢弃，`< topScore − 0.15` 丢弃，`keyword+entity+similarity === 0` 视为 *padding*——只要有词法命中就丢弃 padding。全部都是 padding → 整段省略，连带文档/运行时/提示段一起省略：空召回的一轮至多带缓存的状态行（约 200 字符），状态为空则完全不注入。USAGE_HINT 只在有召回的轮次才配得上它约 330 字符的成本。
- 同会话的运行时条目默认排除：它们已在模型上下文里，重复是为同一段文本付两次钱。重启、新会话或压缩后自然恢复。`MNEMON_RUNTIME_SCOPE=all` 可恢复旧行为。
- 保留结果（≤ 4 条）渲染为紧凑行（`— [0.38·preference] excerpt…`，段 ≤ 900 字符）；约 30KB 的 verbose JSON 只喂 `JSON.parse`，绝不进模型上下文。状态段压缩为一行（≤ 200 字符），按记忆根缓存 60s。
- CLI 输出为空或不可解析（实测 `SQLITE_BUSY`）时 150ms 后重试一次，仍失败则丢弃该段——注入永不失败。
- 提示告诉模型深度检索是按需的：`mnemon recall "<focused query>" --intent WHY|WHEN|ENTITY --limit 10 --verbose`。

这是降噪，不是精确工程：本库分数聚集在 0.25–0.38，闸门只承诺零信号 padding 绝不进上下文。

## 硬性不变量

这些是承重墙。破坏它们会污染共享状态。

- **绝不写 `runtime/memories.json`。** 该文件是 dsh-mnemon 自己的运行时记忆，schema 不同（`{content, created_at, target, importance}`）。OpenCode 使用 `runtime/opencode-memories.json`（+ `.opencode-memories.lock`）。否则 50 条修剪会删掉 dsh 的条目。
- **绝不写 `documents/`。** 只建索引，不拥有它。
- **用租约，不用永久标记。** claim 写 `claimedAt`；超过 300s 的 claim 可被接管。永久标记曾卡住 11 条。
- **先规则抽取，LLM 只兜底。** `extractMemory(entry) ?? (await llmExtractMemory(entry))`。LLM 调用永不进入写锁，25s 超时（`unref`），失败静默回退规则结果。
- **LLM 入口是 `ctx.generate.text`，不是 session。** V2 `ctx` 上没有 `ctx.session.prompt`，`generate.text` 不会重新进入会话 prompt hook，所以没有递归。`[mnemon-extract]` 标记保留为文本级兜底。

## 部署模型

**推荐：从 npm 安装**。在全局 `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` 的 `plugins` 数组声明发布包，由 OpenCode 自动拉取：

```json
{
  "plugins": [
    "opencode-mnemon"
  ]
}
```

OpenCode 会从 npm 安装到本地缓存（`~/.cache/opencode/npm/opencode-mnemon@latest/`），`opencode plugin list` 应看到 `mnemon` 插件。

**本地回退（不使用 npm 声明的环境）**：用仓库脚本复制到插件槽——注意是**复制**不是符号链接（R11 教训：仓库改名会让符号链接悬空、插件静默失效）。

```sh
npm run deploy                  # ~/.config/opencode/plugins/mnemon.js <- 仓库 mnemon.js（原子替换）
npm run deploy -- --check       # 只比对哈希，不写；漂移非零退出
npm run deploy -- --dry-run     # 打印将要做什么，不写
```

`deploy --check` 的退出码：`0` 同步 / `1` 漂移或源不可读 / `2` 从未部署。测试和 CI 可据此判断是否真的部署过，避免把"本机未部署"误判成"漂移失败"。

> ⚠️ 二选一：npm 声明和 copy 部署**只能留一个**。两者并存 = 同一个 `"mnemon"` id 注册两次，`plugin update` 直接报 `Duplicate plugin ID` 中止。用了 npm 版就别再 `npm run deploy`。

## 记忆层初始化（给新项目建库）

插件是全局的，记忆库按项目隔离：`<project>/.mnemon/` 存在即用项目库，否则回退全局 `~/.mnemon`。新项目建库：

```sh
cd <project>
npx opencode-mnemon         # 在 cwd 建 .mnemon/
npx opencode-mnemon <dir>   # 或指向别的目录
# 旧别名 npx -p opencode-mnemon opencode-mnemon-init 仍可用
```

它创建 `runtime/`、`documents/{active,archived,index.json}`（空库写 `{"documents": []}`，已有不覆盖）和目录内 `.gitignore`（只忽略机器本地的 `data/` + `runtime/`，`documents/` 照常可版本化），最后用 `mnemon --data-dir … status` 证明 CLI 可达并预建 sqlite。幂等：已存在的文件一律保留。

它**绝不碰** `.opencode/` 和项目根 `.gitignore`。如果项目是老办法（官方 `mnemon setup --target opencode`）建的，残留的 `.opencode/plugins/mnemon.js` / `.opencode/skills/mnemon` 会触发警告——删掉它，它和 npm 包重复注册。

CI（`.github/workflows/test.yml`）从 npm 安装 `@mnemon-dev/mnemon`——它公开发布、带各平台二进制、无需凭据——然后在临时 `HOME` 下跑套件，让回退断言碰不到真实记忆根。

## 开关

| 开关 | 范围 | 时机 |
|---|---|---|
| `<root>/opencode-llm-extract` | 按项目 | `touch` 开，`rm` 关，下轮 sweep 生效——无需重启 |
| `MNEMON_LLM_EXTRACT=1` | 进程 | 需重启 |
| `MNEMON_LLM_EXTRACT=0` | 进程 | 总闸，压过标记文件 |
| `MNEMON_LLM_MODEL` | 进程 | 压过标记文件的模型内容 |
| `MNEMON_LLM_MODELS` | 进程 | 逗号分隔 `provider/model`，整体覆盖默认模型链 |
| `MNEMON_AUTOMEM=0` | 进程 | 写侧关闭；**读侧保持开启** |
| `MNEMON_RECALL=0` | 进程 | 召回段关闭；注入至多带状态（文档 / 运行时 / 提示都关闭） |
| `MNEMON_RUNTIME_SCOPE=all` | 进程 | 运行时段包含同会话条目（默认只跨会话） |
| `MNEMON_DEBUG=0` | 进程 | 插件日志完全关闭 |
| `MNEMON_DEBUG_LOG=<path>` | 进程 | 覆盖插件日志路径（默认 OS 临时目录 `mnemon-plugin-debug.log`） |
| `MNEMON_DISABLE=1` | 进程 | 总闸，**读写两侧都停止**（`TRELLIS_HOOKS=0` / `TRELLIS_DISABLE_HOOKS=1` 作 legacy 兼容保留） |

标记文件的非空内容被视为模型 ID。

**环境开关是进程级的。** 每个插件实例都活在后端常驻的 OpenCode *server* 进程里，所以 `MNEMON_DISABLE=1 opencode run ...` 无效——`opencode run` 是客户端，环境变量到不了 server。请在启动 server 的环境里导出。这也意味着环境开关无法按项目隔离；要按项目用标记文件。

## LLM 模型解析

模型按 live 目录解析，绝不硬编码——硬编码一个不在 `ctx.model.list()` 里的 provider，每次调用都会失败。

- `pickModelRef(models, wanted)` 按 `[configured, ...llmModelChain()]` 顺序搜索。目录为空 → 信任配置；无匹配 → `null` 并静默放弃。
- 默认链 `["opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash", "opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash", "opencode-gemini-3.5-flash-lite", "opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-free"]`，`MNEMON_LLM_MODELS`（逗号分隔 `provider/model`）可整体覆盖。`LLM_MODEL_CHAIN` 保留作兼容别名。
- `ctx.model.list()` 返回 `{ location, data }` ——取 `.data`。
- 模型引用必须是 `{ id, modelID, providerID }` 且 **`id` 必须是裸 modelID**。传完整 `provider/model` 字符串会被重新拼成 `provider/provider/model`。只有 `{ id }` 会报 `Missing key at ["model"]["providerID"]`；裸字符串报 `Expected Model.Ref | null`；省略 `model` 命中免费档，它会拒绝 OpenCode 外部的调用。

以上全部是探测出来的，不是读文档读出来的。

## mnemon 调用

`PATH` 上的 `mnemon` 是 npm JS 启动器；`SIGKILL` 它会留下孤儿原生子进程。`mnemonCommand()` 解析真实原生二进制一次并缓存：`realpathSync` 检测 `bin/mnemon.js` → 读 `targets.json` 找平台/架构匹配 → `createRequire` 解析 optional 依赖。win32 走 `.cmd` shim 分支。解析到例如 `.../@mnemon-dev/mnemon-darwin-x64/bin/mnemon`。

## 文档

`docs/prd.md`、`docs/design.md`、`docs/implement.md` 保存需求、技术设计与带验证证据的执行记录。Trellis 任务目录 `~/project/others/.trellis/tasks/10-11-mnemon-recall-gate/` 是工作副本；`docs/` 是它的一向快照，因为该任务目录不受任何版本控制，所以 `docs/` 留在 git 里。

编辑任务文档后同步：

```
npm run sync:docs          # 把 prd/design/implement 复制到 docs/
npm run sync:docs:check    # 只报漂移；有漂移非零退出
```

`npm test` 会跑这个检查，所以快照过期套件就会失败。`docs/` 是派生品：绝不要直接编辑它，下次同步会覆盖。

脚本无论任务目录还在活跃（`tasks/<slug>/`）还是已归档（`tasks/archive/<YYYY-MM>/<slug>/`）都能找到——归档会移动它，而已归档任务仍是事实来源。用 `MNEMON_TASK_DIR=...` 或位置参数覆盖。

**找不到任务目录时检查失败而不是通过。** 找不到源就等于没验证任何东西，干净退出看起来像在保护却什么都没查。在确实没有 Trellis 任务目录的机器上，显式退出：

```
MNEMON_TASK_DIR_OPTIONAL=1 npm test
```

`sync:` 不覆盖 `tests/`。它们是这里的活代码，不是快照，绝不会从任务目录写入。`build-mnemon-test.sh` 有意与归档副本不同——仓库版本接受 `MNEMON_PLUGIN_PATH` 和路径参数并校验源存在，归档版硬编码 live 部署路径。归档副本保持原样：它是该任务产出的冻结记录，改写它就是在歪曲历史。
